text:
Claire: Heads up — I'm seeing ~12% of decision logs for /v1/chat missing when requests include an X-Client-Route header. Dashboards still show sampler at 10% but traces show the route evaluated and then no decision_log emitted. Repro below.

Liam: do you have a trace id or example request?

Claire: trace=5654783. Example request headers:
```
Host: api.redwood.dev
X-Client-Route: canary-alpha
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
```
In the eval trace the route matcher picks the canary rule, but downstream I see `decision_log: SKIPPED` in logs.

Ashok: SKIPPED how? sampler should be independent of header overrides. Which component is emitting that line?

Claire: it's from route-eval service (route-eval v2). Log snippet:
```
[2026-05-03T14:12:18Z] trace=5654783 route=/v1/chat matched=canary-alpha headers_normalized=true sampler_eval=false decision_log=SKIPPED reason="sampled_out"
```
That `headers_normalized=true` line is suspicious — seems normalization happened before we evaluated sampler in some code paths but not others.

Jordan: can you dump the decision span? are we sampling before or after header normalization? Our intended order is: normalize headers -> route match -> sampler eval -> decision log emit.

Claire: right, but the service has a new `prefix-override` optimization that short-circuits route match for some headers. I think the sampler hook is registered before that short-circuit and therefore sometimes bypassed.

Maya: on the dashboard I can see a disparity between `route_eval.count` and `decision_log.count` for canary routes starting yesterday. Looks like ~11-13% gap. I pushed a quick chart: https://grafana/redwood/d/route-sampling/gap-canary (private link)

Ashok: let's reproduce with the replay tool.

replay-bot: started replay job 9803 for trace=5654783 (limit=50)

Ashok: running `./infra/replay --job 9803 --service route-eval --follow` now. Command picks up the same execution path.

(replay-bot updates) replay-bot: job 9803: 12 runs executed, 2 mismatched decision_log emits (expected present, found missing)

Claire: reproduces locally for me too. I attached a minimal config that triggers short-circuit:
```
route:
  - match: prefix "/v1/chat"
    override_header: X-Client-Route
    short_circuit: true
sampling:
  mode: global
  rate: 0.1
```
Behavior: when `short_circuit=true` we call `apply_override()` which rewrites path and returns early; sampler callback lives in the main loop after `apply_override` in most paths but the short-circuit path returns before invoking it.

Jordan: that's clearly a bug in registration order. Two options: (A) ensure sampler runs earlier (before short-circuit) or (B) make short-circuit paths call sampler hook before returning. I prefer B to keep sampler semantics tied to the final matched route.

Maya: option B makes sense for accuracy. Also need to update decision log coverage metric to tag these short-circuit cases for future debugging.

Ashok: I'll open a small PR to call `invokeSampler()` inside the short-circuit path and add a unit test to assert decision_log emitted. Assigning to me.

Claire: thanks. Also can we add a temporary dashboard alert when `route_eval.count - decision_log.count > 0.05 * route_eval.count` for any route? That'll catch regressions earlier.

Jordan: I'll add an alert rule and a dashboard annotation for the PR deployment.

(replay-bot) replay-bot: job 9803: test run after patch candidate shows decision_log present for all 12 runs.

Ashok: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/route-eval/pull/421 — moves sampler invocation into short-circuit path + test.

Maya: I'll run the regression suite and promote the change to canary.

Claire: canary run looks good so far, gap down to 0.4%. Looks like resolution holds.

Jordan: alert added and annotated. Also added a small note in the runbook: "sampling hooks must be invoked for all route match exit paths (including short-circuits/overrides)."

Ashok: PR merged at 2026-05-03T15:05:23Z. Rolling to prod in 10m.

Claire: great, thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Ashok -> add integration test for header-override+sampler in CI; Jordan -> keep the alert for two weeks; Maya -> run one more sweep for older traces and close the monitoring ticket if no regression.

Liam: nice find. :tada:
